title: Astro Portal session event payload: device_goto
description: A pointing the person (or the execution's automatic pointing after the launch gesture) asked of a smart telescope in mode expérimental, with the application's immediate answer: `sent` — the device did not refuse; `refused` — the pointing safety or the device refused before anything moved. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

targetId.description: The plan's key of the target the mount was sent to, the same one the target events use (a calibration star or a polar-alignment move carries its own key).

targetLabel.description: The target's display name (« M110 »), for a reader that cannot resolve `targetId`.

reason.description: Optional, with `outcome: refused`: a short machine code of the cause (`below_horizon`, `parked`, `not_aligned`, `zenith`…), never a sentence.

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.
